subject: Inquiry About Sandbox Environment for Testing Data
body:
Hi Sara,
I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to check if there is a sandbox environment available for us to use when entering the "testing data" into the Avicenna app. Dr. Hagerman is currently in the process of testing the logic, and having access to a sandbox would ensure everything functions as expected rather than having in live production and having to delete weekly.
Please let me know if this is something that can be set up or if there are any next steps we should follow.
Thank you for your help!
Janet

subject: Inquiry About Sandbox Environment for Testing Data
body:
Hi Janet,

I hope you're doing well too! Yes, we do offer a trial version for testing purposes. There are no restrictions on the features available in the trial version, except that we periodically remove data to ensure we provide better service for licensed studies. This means you and Dr. Hagerman can create a study, play around to configure your protocol, and confirm that everything works as expected. Later on, if you like, you can use it as your actual project and let us know to include it in your license. Just remember to delete any test participants from the study before recruiting the real participants.

Thank you for reaching out, and please let me know if there's anything else you need.

Best,
Sara
